apps.name: Monoposto
apps.localizedDescription:
free paid app Monoposto is an amazing independent racing game with single seater open-wheel cars. Compete in the new 2025 season: there are 34 racing tracks waiting for you.

-Full unlocked game
-No Ads
-34 realistic tracks
-Online Multiplayer Duel
-Quick race, Single Race and Championship mode
-Qualifying session
-Dynamic weather
-Race session with up to 22 cars
-Pit stop during qualify and race
-Car repair and setup during pit stop
-Car setup before the race
-Customization of Cars and Drivers names
-Create your livery
-Choose your Driver
-8 different camera view
-Spectator TV mode race view
-Many options to customize your driving experience
-External and MFi game controller support
